authority_recovery.canonical_objective: Determine whether structured reasoning can be represented by a common architecture; FARA describes a representation and analysis architecture and does not prescribe how reasoning must be performed.
authority_recovery.prompt_discrepancy: The prompt's phrase common architecture across structured reasoning systems is broader than the canonical objective unless read as representability rather than native constitution. Repository authority controls: W3 tests representational existence and preservation, not a necessary architecture of every reasoning process.

frozen_upstream.W1: all seven candidate-primitive independence outcomes remain unresolved
frozen_upstream.W2: coordinate-separation-induced bounded minimality in finite_coordinate_trace_v1 only

proposition.name: P_W3_CTC
proposition.exact: For every member S of frozen class C_W3, there exists a configuration-transition-context trace reconstruction M(S) such that the declared structural, semantic, operational, dependency, information, and historical observations of S are preserved under E_W3, using only machinery declared in the family record.
proposition.candidate_architecture: CTC=(configurations, typed transitions, declared context, observation map, history order)
proposition.system_class: C_W3 is exactly the ten named family specimens in family_results; it is a challenge set, not all reasoning systems and not a statistically representative population.
proposition.equivalence: E_W3 is equality of each family's independently declared observable values in all six preservation dimensions; missing, ambiguous, or assumed equality is not preservation.
proposition.admissible_auxiliary_machinery: Typed payloads, measures, logics, equations, clocks, sensors, rule/ontology versions, message/event structures, interpreters, and oracles are admissible only when named and charged; auxiliary machinery is not evidence that CTC is native, necessary, unique, or explanatory.

bounded_established_class.membership: Finite or finitely presented, closed, explicitly specified systems whose complete declared observables and transition determinants are available as typed payloads and whose histories are totally ordered or have a declared linearization.
bounded_established_class.result: existential CTC reconstruction preserves the six declared dimensions by construction when every dimension is itself part of the supplied typed payload
bounded_established_class.boundary: This is representational reconstructability with charged payload machinery, not a discovery that CTC is native, necessary, unique, minimal, explanatory, or universal.

family_results.specimen: finite labeled transition system with total next-state function
family_results.mapping: configuration is native state; transition is one function application; context stores alphabet and function; history is the state word
family_results.countermodel_search: Searched bisimilar systems with different state identities; this defeats uniqueness but not observable reconstruction.
family_results.loss_failure_ambiguity: State identity beyond the declared labeling is not invariant; semantic preservation assumes the labeling.

family_results.specimen: finite Markov kernel with exact rational probabilities
family_results.mapping: configuration is state; typed transition payload is the probability kernel rather than one sampled edge
family_results.countermodel_search: Searched non-rational and noncomputable measures; they escape finite explicit payloads and require a measure oracle.
family_results.loss_failure_ambiguity: Sample identity and noncomputable measures are not recovered from the kernel alone.

family_results.specimen: finite default theory with explicit priority relation
family_results.mapping: configuration is current extension plus active defaults; transitions add or retract conclusions; context contains defaults and priorities
family_results.countermodel_search: Searched theories with multiple extensions; selecting one trace silently loses alternative extensions unless the full extension set is payload.
family_results.loss_failure_ambiguity: No semantics-independent mapping; multiple extensions require branching machinery.

family_results.mapping: configuration carries positive and negative support independently; transitions apply the paraconsistent calculus
family_results.countermodel_search: Searched classical Boolean flattening; it is a rejected mapping because contradiction status and non-explosion are lost.
family_results.loss_failure_ambiguity: Success depends on retaining the native nonclassical calculus as auxiliary machinery.

family_results.specimen: finite acyclic structural causal model with interventions
family_results.mapping: configuration is endogenous assignment; context carries equations/exogenous assignment; typed transitions distinguish intervention from observation
family_results.countermodel_search: Searched observationally equivalent causally distinct models; ordinary transition traces conflate them unless equations and intervention semantics are added.
family_results.loss_failure_ambiguity: Counterfactual histories are not actual histories and require the SCM payload.

family_results.specimen: hybrid system with real-valued flow and discrete guards
family_results.mapping: configuration is real-valued state and mode; a transition may carry an entire solution segment plus guard/reset
added_machinery: ODE solver or exact solution oracle
family_results.countermodel_search: Searched Zeno and noncomputable-flow cases; finite event traces lose limit behavior and exact execution may require an oracle.
family_results.loss_failure_ambiguity: Exact semantic, operational, and information preservation is unproved; trajectory payload risks making the architecture vacuous.

family_results.specimen: closed-loop agent whose environment supplies a continuous sensor stream
family_results.mapping: configuration pairs controller state with an environment snapshot; transitions carry actuator and sensor events
family_results.countermodel_search: Searched identical controller states in different unobserved environments; future behavior differs, so internal state is insufficient.
family_results.loss_failure_ambiguity: Expanding configuration to the world smuggles the missing environment into the representation and does not prove an internal common architecture.

family_results.specimen: system that replaces inference rules and splits an ontology term during execution
family_results.mapping: configuration versions rules, signature, ontology, and migration relation; meta-transitions modify them
family_results.countermodel_search: Searched meaning change without a cross-version alignment; no fact determines whether old and new commitments are equivalent.
family_results.loss_failure_ambiguity: A fixed meta-language may merely relocate changing rules; semantic identity across ontology change is underdetermined.

family_results.specimen: asynchronous message-passing agents with concurrent independent events
family_results.mapping: configuration is a global cut; transitions are events; context includes local states, channels, and happens-before partial order
family_results.countermodel_search: Searched two concurrent events with no causal order; either total trace invents historical order, while quotienting interleavings requires an event-structure equivalence.
family_results.loss_failure_ambiguity: Plain CTC total history fails historical preservation; enriched partial-order machinery changes the candidate.

family_results.specimen: two executions with identical explicit internal configuration and trace but an external oracle returns different truth values for the same query
family_results.mapping: strongest mapping adds oracle identity, query/answer transcript, and interpreter to context; no internal-state-only mapping distinguishes executions
family_results.countermodel_search: The paired executions are a direct countermodel: identical internal reconstruction inputs require identical outputs, but the oracle-dependent declared observations differ.
family_results.loss_failure_ambiguity: Adding the oracle makes reconstruction possible but concedes that the proposed explicit internal architecture was insufficient.

adjudication.strongest_established: Existential CTC reconstruction for B_W3_closed_explicit, where every preserved dimension and determinant is already supplied in charged typed payloads.
refuted: lossless universal reconstruction from explicit internal state alone
unresolved: one non-vacuous architecture for all ten specimens
semantic and operational preservation for continuous, embodied, changing-ontology, distributed, and oracle-dependent cases
adjudication.fail_closed_reason: Five favorable bounded encodings do not discharge unresolved dimensions, and auxiliary payload success cannot be promoted to native structure, necessity, or universality.

remaining_obligations: Freeze a non-candidate-defined population if a claim beyond the ten challenge specimens is sought.
Give an independently justified non-vacuity bound on typed payload and oracle machinery.
Define semantic identity across ontology change.
Choose partial-order rather than total-trace historical equivalence for distributed systems or accept historical loss.
Prove or refute exact preservation for continuous noncomputable and Zeno dynamics.
Test embodied systems without treating the whole environment as hidden state.
Obtain independent counterexample replication before any promotion.

self_review.circularity: No architecture claim is used to admit the ten specimens.
self_review.smuggled_architecture: CTC can copy arbitrary payload; the bounded result is expressly classified as by-construction reconstruction.
self_review.equivalence_rigging: E_W3 requires all six independently named dimensions and treats ambiguity as failure, not success.
self_review.hidden_state_or_oracle: Environment, solvers, interpreters, transcripts, and oracles are charged in each record.
self_review.bounded_vs_universal: Separated; the challenge set is not a population and open-world universality remains unresolved.
